title: News Sentiment Classifier — 新闻情感分类器
description: Implement a Chinese financial news sentiment classifier with bullish/bearish/neutral classification and aspect-level granularity. The classifier MUST achieve >85% accuracy on financial news, use the 500+ term domain lexicon from F-044, handle negation and degree modifiers, and output SentimentResult frozen dataclass. Depends on F-044 Sentiment Lexicon for domain-specific scoring.

criteria: SentimentResult frozen dataclass with 5 fields: [label, confidence, score, aspect_sentiments, processing_time_ms]
AspectSentiment frozen dataclass with 3 fields: [aspect, label, confidence]
5+ aspects supported: [earnings, management, market, regulatory, risk]
16+ unit tests pass: verify by py -m pytest tests/unit/test_sentiment_classifier.py -p no:asyncio -q (exit code 0)
All frozen dataclasses use frozen=True, slots=True pattern
convergence.definition_of_done: Sentiment classifier achieves >85% accuracy on financial news with aspect-level granularity

files.change: NewsSentimentClassifier with classify() method, lexicon-based scoring, aspect detection, confidence computation
AspectDetector: identify financial aspects (earnings/management/market/regulatory/risk) in text segments
16+ tests covering: bullish/bearish/neutral classification, aspect sentiment, negation handling, edge cases, frozen dataclass

implementation.title: Implement AspectDetector
implementation.description: Create synapse/nlp/aspect_detector.py with AspectDetector class. Identifies financial aspects in text segments using keyword matching: earnings (业绩/利润/营收), management (管理层/CEO/董事长), market (市场/股价/估值), regulatory (政策/监管/合规), risk (风险/诉讼/处罚). Returns list of (aspect, text_segment) pairs.
logic_flow: Define ASPECT_KEYWORDS dict mapping aspect→keyword list

implementation.title: Implement NewsSentimentClassifier
implementation.description: Create synapse/nlp/sentiment_classifier.py with NewsSentimentClassifier. Pipeline: (1) TextPreprocessor, (2) EnhancedLexiconAnalyzer.score(), (3) AspectDetector for aspect-level sentiment, (4) Threshold-based label assignment (score > 0.1 → bullish, < -0.1 → bearish, else neutral), (5) Confidence = abs(score).
logic_flow: Compute overall lexicon score via EnhancedLexiconAnalyzer
Detect aspects and compute per-aspect scores

implementation.title: Write sentiment classifier tests
implementation.description: Create tests/unit/test_sentiment_classifier.py with 16+ tests: bullish text, bearish text, neutral text, mixed sentiment, aspect detection, negation handling (不看好→bearish), degree modifiers (非常看好→higher confidence), edge cases, frozen dataclass.
logic_flow: Test bullish: '业绩大幅增长超预期'→bullish
Test bearish: '亏损扩大,业绩下滑'→bearish
Test neutral: '公司召开股东大会'→neutral
Test mixed: '业绩增长但估值偏高'→depends on score
Test aspect: earnings vs management aspects
